headline: South Korea’s Economy Expands
what: South Korea’s economy grew 1.0% from the prior quarter and 3.4% from a year earlier.
context: Semiconductor demand remained an important part of the expansion.
why_it_matters: Korea sits near the center of the global chip supply chain, giving the report relevance for U.S. technology demand.

headline: Seoul Stocks Jump
what: South Korea’s main stock index gained 3.1% Tuesday.
context: Large chipmakers helped lead the advance.
why_it_matters: Korean shares provide an early view of global semiconductor demand before U.S. trading begins.

headline: Global Rate Decisions Approach
what: The Federal Reserve and other major central banks are entering closely watched policy meetings.
context: Government bond yields remain elevated in several large economies.
why_it_matters: Different rate paths can move currencies, borrowing costs, and demand for U.S. exports.
